title: Official solution check
help: After each save, Cove runs the saved official solutions on every test case, the same way a student's submission is graded. This is a warning only; saving and publishing are never blocked.

status.PASSED_one: All {{cases}} cases passed with the official solution.
status.PASSED_other: All {{cases}} cases passed with {{count}} official solutions.
status.FAILED: The official solution fails some test cases. Check the test data.
status.NO_SOLUTION: No official solution is saved, so this problem can't be checked.
status.NOT_CHECKABLE: This problem can't be checked automatically (no test cases, or not a Python problem).
status.ERRORED: The check couldn't run. Run it again in a moment.
status.NONE: Not checked yet. Run a check to test the saved test cases.

stale: The test cases changed after this check. Save or run the check again.

hint.cut: This test data is exactly {{length}} characters long. A spreadsheet probably cut it (Excel keeps 32,767 characters, Google Sheets 50,000). Paste the full data here in Edit.
hint.WRONG_OUTPUT: The expected output may be wrong, or the official solution is.
hint.RUNTIME_ERROR: The input may be cut short or in a different format than the problem statement says.
hint.TIME_LIMIT: The official solution is slower than this case's time limit.
hint.MEMORY_LIMIT: The official solution uses more memory than this problem allows.

run_failed: The check couldn't be started. Try again.
